attributes.name: Sir John Rose
attributes.summary: Sir John Rose joined Rolls-Royce Group plc in 1984 and was Chief Executive from 1996 to March 2011. He is Chairman of the Holdingham Group, Deputy Chairman of Rothschild Group and a Director of BW Shipping. Sir John is an Adviser to the Greenbriar Equity Group and the Abu Dhabi Executive Affairs Authority. He is also a trustee of the Eden Project and the Baker Dearing Trust.
